dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「お帰り、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Welcome back, nii-san."
dialogues.text: "Welcome back, nii-san."

dialogues.jp: 先に帰っていた音夢がテレビを見ていた。
dialogues.en: Nemu, who reached home first, was watching television.
dialogues.text: Nemu, who reached home first, was watching television.

dialogues.jp: 「ただいま」
dialogues.en: "I'm home."
dialogues.text: "I'm home."

dialogues.jp: 言いながらソファーにドフッと腰を沈める。
dialogues.en: With that, I sank my body into the sofa.
dialogues.text: With that, I sank my body into the sofa.

dialogues.jp: 「どこに遊びに行ってたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Where did you go today?"
dialogues.text: "Where did you go today?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「美春の家でお喋りして、公園の屋台でクレー
　プ食べてきたの」
dialogues.en:
"I chatted with Miharu for a while at her house, then went
to the park and ate a crepe from a roadside vendor."
dialogues.text:
"I chatted with Miharu for a while at her house, then went
to the park and ate a crepe from a roadside vendor."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.jp:
さっき美春はマンガを返しに来たとか言ってた
けど……。
dialogues.en: Earlier, Miharu said she was returning a manga to Nemu...
dialogues.text: Earlier, Miharu said she was returning a manga to Nemu...

dialogues.jp:
相変わらずドジだな、美春は。音夢が家に行っ
たのなら、その時に返せば良いものを……。
dialogues.en:
As forgetful as ever, that Miharu. It would certainly have
been easier to return the manga when Nemu went to her
house...
dialogues.text:
As forgetful as ever, that Miharu. It would certainly have
been easier to return the manga when Nemu went to her
house...

dialogues.jp:
いや、今日音夢が貸した本……ということもあ
るか？
dialogues.en: Well, maybe Nemu lent her the book today?
dialogues.text: Well, maybe Nemu lent her the book today?

dialogues.jp: だとしたら、随分と急な話だけどな。
dialogues.en: If so, she must've really rushed through it...
dialogues.text: If so, she must've really rushed through it...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「それより兄さん……はい、お土産♪」
dialogues.en: "By the way, nii-san... here you go, a present♪"
dialogues.text: "By the way, nii-san... here you go, a present♪"

dialogues.jp:
不敵な笑顔を浮かべて、音夢が箱状の包みを差
し出してくる。バレーボールでも入っていそう
なデカさだ。
dialogues.en:
With a fearless-looking smile, Nemu gave me a box-shaped
parcel. It was about the size of a volleyball.
dialogues.text:
With a fearless-looking smile, Nemu gave me a box-shaped
parcel. It was about the size of a volleyball.

dialogues.jp: チッ、チッ、チッ――
dialogues.en: --Tick, Tick, Tick
dialogues.text: --Tick, Tick, Tick

dialogues.en: "...A bomb?"
dialogues.text: "...A bomb?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「どうして私がそんな物を買わなくちゃならな
　いのよ」
dialogues.en: "Why would I buy you something like that?"
dialogues.text: "Why would I buy you something like that?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「いや、ストレス解消に」
dialogues.en: "To relieve you of your stress?"
dialogues.text: "To relieve you of your stress?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことしません……」
dialogues.en: "Uhm, no, not really..."
dialogues.text: "Uhm, no, not really..."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「だいたい、そんなことをしたら私まで巻き込
　まれちゃうじゃない」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, hurry up and open it. I want to see your reaction."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, hurry up and open it. I want to see your reaction."

dialogues.jp: こいつの側から離れないようにしよう。
dialogues.en: She's not going to leave my side until I open it.
dialogues.text: She's not going to leave my side until I open it.

dialogues.jp:
そんなことを半ば本気で考えながら、とりあえ
ず中身を確認する。
dialogues.en:
I half-seriously think that to myself as I examine the
outside of the parcel once more.
dialogues.text:
I half-seriously think that to myself as I examine the
outside of the parcel once more.

dialogues.jp: 箱を開けると、球状の物体が顔を覗かせた。
dialogues.en:
As I opened the box, a ball-shaped thing started to peep
out.
dialogues.text:
As I opened the box, a ball-shaped thing started to peep
out.

dialogues.jp: 「……なに、これ？」
dialogues.en: "...What is this?"
dialogues.text: "...What is this?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「目覚まし時計」
dialogues.en: "An alarm clock."
dialogues.text: "An alarm clock."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "Hah?"
dialogues.text: "Hah?"

dialogues.jp:
箱から持ち上げてみると、確かに時を刻んでい
る。
dialogues.en: I lift the box up, and let it tick for a bit.
dialogues.text: I lift the box up, and let it tick for a bit.

dialogues.jp: 「何で丸いんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why is it spherical?"
dialogues.text: "Why is it spherical?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「あは、それね、止めようとするとコロがって
　行くんだって」
dialogues.en: "Aha, that's because if you try to stop it, it'd roll away."
dialogues.text: "Aha, that's because if you try to stop it, it'd roll away."

dialogues.en: --Hah?
dialogues.text: --Hah?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「センサーがついてて、触ろうとするとコロコ
　ロ転がって、逃げてくみたい」
dialogues.en:
"It has inbuilt sensors, so you won't be able to just switch
it off easily anymore."
dialogues.text:
"It has inbuilt sensors, so you won't be able to just switch
it off easily anymore."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「がんばってね、兄さん♪」
dialogues.en: "Do your best, nii-san♪"
dialogues.text: "Do your best, nii-san♪"

dialogues.jp:
音夢のとっても楽しそうな笑顔に、俺もなんだ
か楽しくなる……。
dialogues.en:
Nemu is so happily smiling, so how can I not be happy as
well...
dialogues.text:
Nemu is so happily smiling, so how can I not be happy as
well...

dialogues.jp: （訳ないだろ――っ！）
dialogues.en: "(EASILY--!)"
dialogues.text: "(EASILY--!)"

dialogues.jp:
まあ、いい。所詮は目覚まし。動きのパターン
など、たかが知れている。
dialogues.en:
Well, whatever. In the end, it's just an alarm clock. I'd
eventually figure out it's movement patterns.
dialogues.text:
Well, whatever. In the end, it's just an alarm clock. I'd
eventually figure out it's movement patterns.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「それより兄さん。今日の夕飯、外で食べな
　い？」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah, brother. About tonight's dinner, can we eat out?"
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah, brother. About tonight's dinner, can we eat out?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ん？　別にいいけど」
dialogues.en: "Hm? I'm fine with anything."
dialogues.text: "Hm? I'm fine with anything."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「わーい♪」
dialogues.en: "Yaaay♪"
dialogues.text: "Yaaay♪"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ったく、しょうがないな」
dialogues.en: "Hah, you're easy to please."
dialogues.text: "Hah, you're easy to please."

dialogues.jp:
とは言え、俺も腹は減ったし、今から買いに行っ
て戻ってくるのもかったるいしな。まあ、音夢
が買いに行く分には問題ないが。
dialogues.en:
Having said that, my own stomach rumbled. It sounded
troublesome to me to go out, eat and come back, but if Nemu
wants to...
dialogues.text:
Having said that, my own stomach rumbled. It sounded
troublesome to me to go out, eat and come back, but if Nemu
wants to...

dialogues.jp: どうせ行かされるのは俺だろうし……。
dialogues.en: Besides, I just agreed to it anyway...
dialogues.text: Besides, I just agreed to it anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「で、どちらでご馳走して下さるの？」
dialogues.en: "So, what are you treating me to?"
dialogues.text: "So, what are you treating me to?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんで、俺が｛おご／奢｝らにゃならんのだ！？」
dialogues.en: "Why do I need to treat you!?"
dialogues.text: "Why do I need to treat you!?"

dialogues.jp: にこやかな笑顔で｛・・・／ぬかす｝音夢に疑問を提起する。
dialogues.en:
I leave out the sarcastic smile I usually give in these
kinds of situation.
dialogues.text:
I leave out the sarcastic smile I usually give in these
kinds of situation.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「はぁ……では人件費込みで、１０，０００円
　になります」
dialogues.en:
"Haah... if that's how it is, please pay me 10,000 yen for
personnel expenses."
dialogues.text:
"Haah... if that's how it is, please pay me 10,000 yen for
personnel expenses."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はい？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「目覚まし代♪」
dialogues.en: "For buying your alarm clock♪"
dialogues.text: "For buying your alarm clock♪"

dialogues.jp: にこやかに見つめ合う、兄と妹。
dialogues.en: the brother and sister exchanged glances and smiles.
dialogues.text: the brother and sister exchanged glances and smiles.

dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、行こうか音夢。今日は俺の奢りだ」
dialogues.en: "Let's go Nemu, today, dinner's on me!"
dialogues.text: "Let's go Nemu, today, dinner's on me!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ありがと、兄さん」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, nii-san!"
dialogues.text: "Thank you, nii-san!"

dialogues.jp:
俺のさしだした手に、お姫様のように手を重ね
て音夢が笑顔で立ちあがった。
dialogues.en:
I stuck out my hand, and the princess smilingly used mine to
stand up.
dialogues.text:
I stuck out my hand, and the princess smilingly used mine to
stand up.

dialogues.jp: ◆目覚ましプレゼント◆
dialogues.en: ◆Alarm clock present◆
dialogues.text: ◆Alarm clock present◆

dialogues.jp: 家に帰ると、音夢も帰っていた。
dialogues.en: When I returned home, Nemu had already came back.
dialogues.text: When I returned home, Nemu had already came back.

dialogues.jp:
そして、お土産などと称して、俺に目覚まし時
計をくれた。
dialogues.en: Then I received a present, a new alarm clock.
dialogues.text: Then I received a present, a new alarm clock.

dialogues.jp:
そして、目覚まし代のカタに、夕食を奢ってく
れなどとぬかす音夢。全く……。
dialogues.en:
And in return for the cost of the clock, Nemu strong-armed
me into treating her for dinner. Seriously...
dialogues.text:
And in return for the cost of the clock, Nemu strong-armed
me into treating her for dinner. Seriously...
